sources.name: molmoact_household
sources.real_robot_evidence: Ai2's in-house MolmoAct real-robot collection: a single-arm Franka in home environments (MolmoAct paper, 10k trajectories over 93 tasks; MolmoAct2 re-release with per-episode language annotations).
sources.state_semantics: End-effector pose: x, y, z in metres, then three Euler angles (roll wraps at +-pi in the source), then the gripper position as a 0-1 ratio. Not joint positions.
sources.action_semantics: The source's action.abs_ee_action is bit-identical to observation.state at the same timestep (measured max |diff| 0.0 on the Tabletop shard), and action.del_ee_action is the one-step state difference. The measured pose is therefore copied into the action vector under the audited copy_state exception; the Euler triple is unwrapped per episode at ingest so anchor deltas never cross the +-pi seam.
sources.gripper_semantics: Gripper position ratio in [~-0.013, 1.0]; open/closed orientation is not stated by the card and must not be inferred.
sources.notes: 15 Hz, 7,529 episodes over 115 tasks, median 7.6 s per episode. Three cameras (primary, secondary, wrist) at 480x640. The base policy (MolmoAct2) was pretrained on this data. Sampling is two episodes per task for scene/task coverage rather than depth within a task.
